exposure.needed: whether the operator's scripts or workflows invoke the flux image CLI commands that were promoted to stable

original.statement: The flux 2.7.0 release notes state that the image CLI commands are promoted to stable; the note describes no functional change, so an operator sees no operational consequence.

decision.reason: [ev-44874a28f96d] only says the flux image CLI commands were promoted to stable. It doesn't name the commands and gives no cluster-side condition. Whether someone is affected depends on whether their scripts or workflows run these CLI commands. No manifest, Helm value or cluster state shows that, so undecidable with environment-visibility-gap is a fair exposure condition and doesn't over-claim.
